venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Wednesday 10/28 (MOD MKZ/jk; entered by Mya; posted 11:38pm 10/28).** Net $1,258 vs $1,475 target (-15%). Food $369. Comps $13.60. 34 guests, $37.01 avg. Halloween Wednesday trivia was a great time; quiet at open but bar top and booths were full by trivia start. Show trivia specials and point out other activations. Jon trained today and is getting more comfortable in the space. Space emptied after trivia with a few regulars. Kitchen: smooth. Favorite moment: seeing regulars who had been out of town.

venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Wednesday 10/28 (MOD MD & KK / Chef DM; entered by BC; posted 2:08am 10/29).** Net $1,258 vs $1,018 target (+24%). Food $150. Comps $35.80 (2.8%) — trivia coupon, manager comp, industry. 43 guests, $29.26 avg. Sleepy start ($288 net at 7pm); trivia drew only two teams so it was halved. First steady volume ~8:40pm until ~10:30pm; empty by 11pm. Two industry first-timers (Tessa, Kathleen) stayed until ~8pm. 86: Ponies, Rosé, NA Beer. Low: Hazy. Kitchen: Danny held it down.

venues.narrative: **DVR — Wednesday 10/28 (AM Maggie S & Josh; PM Graham & Lucas; entered by Graham; posted 2:11am 10/29).** Net incl. events $17,151.19 (no target reported). DC/AM $898.49, D&C PM $6,476.70; net ex-events $7,375.19. Food incl. events $7,909.20 (food ex-events $1,429.20). Break make-up not complete.

venues.weather: Chilly but perfect jacket fall weather
venues.narrative: **EV — Wednesday 10/28 (MOD/Chef Kyler & Steves; entered by Thomas; posted 2:02am 10/29).** Net $4,789 vs $4,592 target (+4%). Food $551, Beverage $4,238. Comps $223.52 (largely community members). 130 guests (SevenRooms), $37 avg. Strong first turn, fallow around 8pm, resurgence ~9pm, mellowed from 10:30. 130 covers, 2 large parties, 8 solos, 6 investor cocktails; ~85% of parties after 7pm were 2 or fewer. Top sellers: Rosalie, Burner Phone, Cloudwalk. Sean's mom visited; B.J. Novak inquired about hours. 1 no-show (Carter McAlister, 2 @ 8:30). Breakage: 1 SOF. Menu count 17.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Wednesday 10/28 (MOD/Chef Joe + Kevin; entered by Joe; posted 5:29am 10/29).** Net $7,460 vs $4,574 target (+63%). Food $805. Event sales $3,160 (Standing Room private event, 20 ppl 4-7pm, ~12 showed); Marquee $4,300. Comps $116 (Mia's fiancé, Angel, Andrea, Bryan, investor, DNL). 104 guests, $89.60 avg. Mellow Wednesday, ~10 covers on books; Chelsea's first live shift went great; normal push ~9:30pm then mellowed. Team decked out Standing Room for the holiday weekend. Kitchen: crushed it. No incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Wednesday 10/28 (MOD Marcus; entered by Marcus; posted 12:33am 10/29).** Net incl. events $2,833.53 vs $4,519 target (-37%). Marquee bar sales $3,116.88 (gross). Food $328. Comps $15 (gift). 75 guests (51 walk-in / 24 reso), $37.78 avg (GCA reported $38.29). Another slower night; hoped for convention foot traffic (Care at Home expo, AIPLA at Westin) that never materialized. Biggest pop around 8; last call 11:30. Staff cuts made smoothly. Improvement: get ahead of nearby events with outreach. Maintenance: curtain.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Wednesday 10/28 (AM Franck & Lex; PM Justin & Drew; entered by Justin; posted 11:41pm 10/28).** Net $8,591 vs $8,051 target (+7%). Food $3,789. Comps $160.15. 223 guests (47 AM + 176 PM, OpenTable), $38.52 avg. Municipal AM $2,073, PM $6,144, Sun Club $375, Hot Eye $0. Slower than the past couple of nights (film fest lacking big stars); small between-screens rush at happy hour, one easy pop in the 9:00 hour, slow close. Kitchen: cold mussels the only complaint; no 86s. Incident/injury reported YES (details not in report). Favorite moment: Ron Howard passing through.

venues.narrative: **SEA — Wednesday 10/28 (MOD Curtis Hayes; entered by Curtis Hayes; posted 3:48am 10/29).** Net $8,896 vs $6,898 target (+29%). Food $1,487.
